record_type_quote: AIM: To replicate the YSEX? in a broader sample of women and men of different ages.

targets.evidence_quote: INTRODUCTION: 10 years ago, Meston and Buss (Arch Sex Behav 2007;36:477-507) identified 237 reasons for having sex. Since then, only a few studies have built on the analyses of differences in sexual motivation. AIM: To replicate the YSEX? in a broader sample of women and men of different ages.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The abstract identifies the earlier inventory study and the replication aim but does not describe the original findings corresponding to its current sex and age effects or give an overall replication verdict. The full reference list is unavailable; target title and DOI are not supplied.
